chunks: Muhammad ibn 'Ali ibn Mahbub narrated from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn 'Ali, from 'Ali ibn Ya'qub al-Hashimi, from Marwan ibn Muslim, from Ibn Abi Ya'fur, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
Salat al-kusuf consists of ten rak'ahs and four sajdahs. The eclipse of the sun is more severe upon people and animals.

key_terms.صَلَاةُ الْكُسُوفِ: the prayer performed for an eclipse

ai.seo_question: How many rak'ahs and sajdahs are in salat al-kusuf according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states the number of units in salat al-kusuf, identifying it as ten rak'ahs and four sajdahs. It also notes that a solar eclipse has a stronger effect upon people and animals, indicating the gravity of this event within the context of worship.
